blocks.text: 把函数调用交给真实 Worker 执行，通过一套双向请求与流接口管理结果、重启和关闭。

items: 计算移出主线程后仍只检查进程 id，无法确认任务是否进入了不同线程。
Worker 还要调用父端并逐项返回结果，多套消息路由让请求关联与释放重复出现。
发送字节后不知道谁还能使用原 buffer，把复制和转移混在一起造成所有权误判。
重启完成后仍靠固定等待再调用，因为原生启动与应用目录就绪没有对齐。
清理一个组件就关闭共享端口，因为连接的生命周期被误当成原生资源的所有权。
区分真实 Worker 与独立进程。 常见做法只看返回值，本例同时比较原生 pid 和 threadId，证明计算来自同进程的另一线程，见同名场景。
反向请求与结果流使用同一连接。 不必另建父端路由和序列协议，例子分别返回父端处理结果与三个流值，见同名场景。
默认复制保留调用方字节，未授权转移明确拒绝。 不依赖“原生端口就能转移”的假设，例子验证副本修改、原 buffer 和提供方调用次数，见同名场景。
Host 报告重启就绪后可立即调用。 不靠固定延时猜目录是否切换，例子在 ready 后立即读到新 Worker 的初始计数，见同名场景。
逻辑关闭保留借入端口。 不把注销连接等同于销毁物理资源，例子在共享关闭 Promise 完成后仍通过原端口收发，见同名场景。

仅展示同一“发数值、取计算结果”场景，不运行：

import { Worker } from 'node:worker_threads'

const source = `
  import { parentPort } from 'node:worker_threads'
  parentPort.on('message', (value) => parentPort.postMessage(value * 2))
`
const worker = new Worker(new URL('data:text/javascript,' + encodeURIComponent(source)))
worker.once('message', (value) => console.log(value)) // 没有请求标识，并发结果难以对应
worker.postMessage(21) // 没有调用期限或取消路径
void worker // 未安排最终释放，Worker 可能继续存活

blocks.text: 本包创建 Worker、接入消息端口，并把 Worker 的预算、启动、重启和释放交给监督器。调用关联、目录、超时、取消、错误还原和重试归 Core；协议与便携值归 Contract。它适合把解析、压缩、图像处理等计算移出主线程，以及让 Host 统一管理多条 Worker 连接。

线程共享进程，不能代替独立进程的权限或故障隔离。需要独立进程时使用 rpc-process；跨窗口、iframe、SharedWorker、可靠有序 RTCDataChannel 的 Peer 使用 rpc-browser，Service Worker 和 BroadcastChannel 使用该包的 Endpoint transport。SharedArrayBuffer / Atomics 共享内存不在本包支持范围内。

rows: Peer、Plugin、child guard、错误码、高级通道与 Web launcher，以及公开配置和 handle 类型。

blocks.text: 直接安装 Core 与 Contract 两个 peer 依赖；不以硬编码版本相等作为运行时规则。lifecycle、supervision、utils 是运行时依赖。Electron-main 入口另需可选 peer `electron: ^44.0.0`。示例直接导入 PluginHost 或 utils 时，也应直接安装相应包。

Web、Bun、Deno 和 Electron renderer 使用根入口的 `createWebThreadLauncher`、`createWebThreadChannelFactory`。`INodeThreadHandle`、`IWebThreadHandle`、`IWebThreadLauncherOptions` 和高级原生运行时类型从根入口导入。根入口还重新导出 Core 的 typed surface、查询、详情、列表、事件与 thread stop 类型；这些不是另一套调用协议。

`createThreadPeer<TRemote>(options, runtime?)` 返回 typed Peer。`TRemote` 默认 `Record<never, never>`，只约束调用端类型，不注册 Worker 方法。`IRuntimeDynamicSurface` 可以放宽静态路径检查，运行时仍以对端真实目录为准。默认本地身份为 `{ name: 'thread', instanceId: 自动生成值 }`；需要稳定地址时显式传 `self.name`、`self.instanceId`。

主线程可以指定短 `spawn`、完整 `spawn` 或 Core 的 `connect` / `listen` 来源；来源不能混用。库 launcher 创建的 Worker 内省略来源，由真实 Node parentPort / workerData 或 Web Worker bootstrap 自动连接父线程。单独执行普通 Worker 文件不会获得这种连接。`isThreadChild()` 只读取库的启动标记以区分父子分支，不为外部 Worker 授权，也不替代能力确认。
`provide` 缺省不暴露应用方法；自身可枚举数据属性中的函数形成方法，嵌套对象形成点分路径，不接受 accessor 作为方法声明。返回 iterable / async iterable 的方法通过 `stream` 调用。Worker 端也是 Peer，可反向调用父线程的 `provide`。

rows: 等待一次结果，参数形式由真实目录与 typed surface 约束。
单向调用，不提供业务执行完成回执。
逐项消费远端 iterable / async iterable；取消仍依赖远端配合。
复用 Core 的分组、结果对账、目录和事件规则。
调用方释放独立 Peer；spawn 来源还释放它拥有的 Worker，借用来源只释放连接。

blocks.text: `defaultTimeoutMs` 缺省 30000，必须是正有限值，只用于 request / stream。单次 `timeoutMs` 可为非负有限值或 `false`；0 表示立即到期，false 关闭该次期限。全局并发默认 256，每个对端 64，通过 `providerLimits.maxGlobal`、`providerLimits.maxPerPeer` 调整；超额以 `OVERLOADED` 拒绝，不执行该次 provider。设置 `spec.limits.callWallTimeMs` 会进一步压低调用期限。

`signal` 是协作取消，超时、取消或断线都不能证明 Worker 尚未执行。非幂等写入先用业务标识对账；已声明幂等且仍保留结果的调用可结合 `idempotencyKey` / `outcome(key)`，不能把任意重试当作只执行一次。`report` 缺省 Core 的默认诊断输出（通常为 console.error）；它接收后台失败。`probe`、`contract`、`authentication`、`endpointFactory`、`keyFactory`、`retryPort` 延续 Core 各自 owner 的契约。

blocks.text: 短形式只是展开已有完整 source，不允许自报“已经协商”或“已经信任”。监督字段继续由 supervision 校验和执行：

rows: 未设置；可提供真实就绪检查。
省略相当于 mode 为 stay，保持 terminal；另可选 mode 为 cooldown 并提供 afterMs 后重新尝试，terminal 不是“永远无法恢复”。
未设置；绑定先在剩余预算内排空当前调用，再调用自定义钩子。

blocks.text: 默认 RPC health 使用 5000 ms 间隔、2000 ms 单次上限、连续 3 次失败策略。Endpoint 尚未绑定时由原准备期限管理，绑定后只探测该 handle 的真实 Endpoint。显式去掉 ping 却未提供自定义 health 会以 INVALID_CONFIG 拒绝；健康检查不会把 unsupported 原生退出能力变成 enforced。
Node / Bun self spawn 保留运行时 flags；显式不同入口会过滤父进程的 eval、print、测试控制参数，保留 loader 等运行时 flags。REPL、eval、单文件二进制、Electron 和测试运行器等没有可复用主入口时，self spawn 以 INVALID_CONFIG 拒绝，不猜入口；显式可用入口不受“不能 self spawn”的推断限制。

Node 24 可剥离 .ts 类型，但不把相对 `./x.js` 重定向为 `./x.ts`；Bun 支持此映射。含这种 specifier 的工程在 Node / Deno 下使用构建输出或合适 loader，解析错误保留原 cause。浏览器只接受明确 URL，不接受 true / 裸字符串；动态 Worker 构造也不能替代 bundler 的字面量源码发现。应提供预构建模块 URL，或在自定义构造器内保留字面量 Worker 构造。Deno Worker 仍需相应宿主权限。
`createThreadPlugin(options, runtime?)` 复用 Peer 来源、provide 与认证配置，另需 `name`，`expose` 缺省为空数组：不向 Worker 暴露 Host 应用方法。只有明确选中的 Host 路径可见。安装后由 Host 持有连接和 Worker，经 `host.thread` 操作；直接 Peer 则由创建者关闭。

`host.thread.request` / notify / stream / group / outcome 的第一参数是连接名或 `{ name, instanceId }`。list / get 查询连接及当前代次，broadcast 返回每个目标的独立结果，on / watch 复用 Core 事件目录。stop / kill / restart / replace 仅用于 spawn 来源；连接来源不能据此终止外部 Worker。线程 stop 只接受 `{ graceMs }`，出现 signal 字段（即便 undefined）也拒绝。
restart 返回 ready、replace 返回 replaced 时，新代次已经发布进调用目录，可以立即调用，不需额外等待事件或自行退避。替换不会把已发往旧代次的业务自动迁移到新代次。Host 的 execution.mutationTimeoutMs 和 pipelineDrainTimeoutMs 必须显式配置，false 表示不设该预算。

sections.id: 二进制复制-签名与转移
sections.heading: 二进制复制、签名与转移

rows: 默认按值复制，原 buffer 仍可用；Uint8Array 的 offset / length 得到保留。
必须实际协商原生二进制与 transfer 能力，并建立签名认证；不满足时 CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED。
不支持，调用准入时拒绝。

blocks.text: 要使用普通 factory 的签名原生二进制，在双方 `createThreadPeer` 配置 `authentication: { sign, verify }`；无需另建 Endpoint。`sign` 保护完整语义输入及 Core 为原生 backing 计算的摘要，`verify` 必须拒绝伪造签名。该 profile 签名但不加密，encodedType 使用默认 any。能力提案经实际端口双边确认，配置里的字符串不构成信任证据。
使用 HMAC 时，双方从各自部署配置读取同一个密钥；密钥不经 RPC 发送，也不进入日志。可由应用用 createHmac 对完整输入生成签名，verify 先检查签名长度再用 timingSafeEqual 校验，失败抛出认证错误。旧示例中的 RPC_SIGNING_KEY 是应用环境变量名，不是库自动提供的凭据。Node Worker 继承环境，应用应在加载读取密钥的模块前设置部署配置。
buffer 在消息真正提交到原生端口时失效，byteLength 变为 0，共享 backing 的所有 view 同时失效。之后即使对端拒绝签名或调用失败，也不能恢复原 buffer。带 transfer 的调用不自动重试，库不保留输入副本；确认业务结果后按需重新构造数据。这里描述原生转移机制，没有未经测量的速度保证。

`createNodeThreadChannel(port, peerId, options)` 借用 EventEmitter 端口，`createWebThreadChannel` 借用 EventTarget 端口；options.scheduler 必填。未传 capabilities 时使用固定基础 profile，同步返回且不做运行时 hello。固定子集只含 stream / batch 时也走同步固定路径；扩展能力提案返回 Promise，Core 在实际端口等待双边 ACK，缺失或错误 ACK 会拒绝，不能把单方声明当作完成协商。

在 Peer 的 connect callback 中把 `context.capabilities` 交给 channel，并让两端同时开始。context.self 是 Core 为本地准备的真实地址；peerId 表示对端连接。显式 capabilities 可缩小提案，不可扩大实际 launch offer、伪造协商或信任。逻辑 channel.close / Peer.close 解除自己的监听和 observer，不物理关闭借入端口；调用方最后关闭原生端口。固定 raw channel 不等于完整 runtime Peer。

完整 `IRuntimeThreadSpawn` 必填 spec、launcher、budget、scheduler、channelFactory、report；health、supervisor、keyFactory、retryPort 可省略。完整 source 不继承短形式的 isolation 覆盖：省略 supervisor.isolation 时由 supervision 默认 required 处理。spec.entry 是 Node 绝对路径 / file URL，Web 是绝对模块 URL；spec.name / data / limits 可省略。heapBytes 和 callWallTimeMs 是正限制：前者映射为 Node Worker 的 maxOldGenerationSizeMb，后者限制调用期限；不是进程总内存 / 总 CPU 限额。

rows: node 子入口的两个工厂
termination / exit-observation / heap-limit 均 enforced，真实 exit 才结算 exited。
根入口的两个 Web 工厂
termination / exit-observation enforced，原生 Worker 的 close 事件结算 exited；heap-limit unsupported。
根入口的两个 Web 工厂
三项均 unsupported；terminate 请求不产生真实 exit 回执。
electron-main 子入口的两个工厂
复用 worker_threads，但明确三项 unsupported，不把 Node 验证外推到 Electron。

blocks.text: Web launcher 必填 report，可选 Worker 构造器（默认全局 Worker）和 runtimeApi；构造器接收 entry 与 `{ type: 'module', name }`。Node launcher options 默认空对象，可显式 execArgv / runtimeApi；高级 createAdapterNodeThreadLauncher 另接真实 runtime resource。工厂只在实际启动时获取宿主能力。Node 的 sampleUsage 为冷查询：可用时报告该 isolate 的 heap、CPU 微秒和 ELU，sharedPid 只是共享进程身份；缺少原生方法时字段缺席，退出后返回空对象，不拿整个父进程用量冒充线程用量。

handle.identity 含稳定 fingerprint，Node 另含创建时 threadId；handle.port 为实际消息资源，terminate 只请求停止，exited 表示退出，Web 还提供 prepared。Node 由原生 exit、Bun 由原生 Worker close 结算 exited；Deno、浏览器和 Electron renderer 的退出观察为 unsupported，强制回收立即报告 supervision EXIT_UNOBSERVABLE 并保留 abandoned budget lease，不等待 reapTimeoutMs，也不能提前把槽位当空闲。可观察退出超时仍报告 REAP_TIMEOUT；best-effort 准入诊断 CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED 不变。自定义 Node / Web handle 的 open(signal, { scheduler, capabilities? }) 打开对应代次；channel factory 与它使用同一 scheduler。

构造或打开失败时，launcher / 监督 owner 释放已取得监听和候选 Worker；主错误保持原对象或在 cause 链中，清理错误保留在 errors。Node Endpoint 构造失败会回收真实 Worker 和预算；Web 请求 terminate 仍不能补出退出证明。高级调用方若直接 launch，须负责逻辑 channel 关闭、terminate 请求和等待真实 exited 的边界，不能在缺少原生回执的 Web 路径无限 await exited。

AdapterNodeThreadParentChannel 在构造时只保留真实 parentPort，open 才建立固定 profile，不先添加 listener。createAdapterNodeThreadPeer 接收已持有 parentPort 和原始 workerData；runtime resource 的 load 获取真实 Worker 模块，pid 表示共享进程。receiveThreadData 只消费匹配的初始 bootstrap，移除自己的 listener，await prepare(data, peerId) 后发送 ready；返回便携业务 data。readThreadBootstrap 校验并拆出 peerId / data；这些工具不给任意外部 Worker 授权。
新适配器复用 Core adapter SDK 的 defineMessageAdapter；复杂原生组装可使用它的 internal-advanced 入口，不复制能力协商、重试或生命周期 owner。Node Worker 与 Bun 1.4.3 原生 Worker 已有业务与关闭运行证据；这些结果不证明浏览器、Deno 或 Electron 的权限与退出能力。

最终 channel 的 `transport.observe(probe)` 安装物理消息观察；发送、接收各报告一次。发送 detail.transfers 为原生 transfer 列表长度，接收为 -1，因为 structured clone 不能说明收到的 buffer 是复制还是转移。直接 ArrayBuffer / view 的 sizeBytes 是字节长度，其它原生消息为 -1，不通过额外序列化估算对象大小。
仅 probe.capturing 开启时读取内容；未转移内容借用原引用，实际转移的 buffer 在发送前复制以保留观察字节。Core 对 own-data 原生容器的选择性捕获保留 Array、Record、Map、Set 中的环、共享 backing 和未转移对象引用；只经 accessor 返回转移 buffer 的情形不提供额外读取保证，不能为捕获再执行 getter。
probe 失败经 onListenerError 报 Core TRANSPORT，原异常保留在 cause，消息仍继续发送和接收。重复 observe 替换旧代，旧 disposer 不会移除新代；当前 disposer、逻辑 close 和既有原生 terminal 路径退休观察。借用端口 close 不改变物理端口所有权，也不改变既有监听与错误 cause 次序。
下表区分线程采样、监督、Core 与 Remote 的错误来源。线程 API 从 `@migaia/rpc-threads` 导入；Core 与 Remote API 分别从 `@migaia/rpc-core` 和 `@migaia/rpc-core/remote` 导入，`source` 值保留各自的错误身份。

rows: 线程 CPU / 内存采样失败，原因为 cause；显示不可用，不据此改变 Worker 生命周期。
退出观察明确不支持；立即 abandoned，不等回收窗口，租约仍保留。
入口、来源、bootstrap、能力 ACK、portable data 或配置不合法；检查字段与 cause。
原生消息 I/O / 启动资源边界失败，保留原生错误类型和原因。
TimeoutError；Worker 可能已执行，先对账。
AbortError；协作取消，不能证明业务未执行。
并发额度满，provider 未调用，降低并发后重试。
需要未协商能力，例如未签名的 transfer。
当前目录没有该目标，检查名字和当前代次。
连接或代次已关闭，重新选择目标，并对已发调用对账。

blocks.text: Node launcher 的原生 Worker 构造参数被拒绝时，使用 Core INVALID_CONFIG 标识；若已有原生 code，则以包装错误保留原 Error、name、message、stack 和原生 code 于 cause，不覆盖它们。此分类只描述 Node 构造边界，不泛化为所有 Web 构造器异常。

本包本地错误码对象 RpcThreadErrorCode 只有 usageSampleFailed，值为 THREAD_USAGE_SAMPLE_FAILED，RPC_THREAD_ERROR_SOURCE 为 `@migaia/rpc/threads`。调用、监督和 Host 边界各使用自己的 source，不把所有失败改成本包采样码。按 source / code 分支，不匹配 message 文本；业务异常跨 Worker 后保留原生类型、message、stack、source/code 与 cause / errors 链，不能承诺接收端对象与发送端同一 identity。
Worker 单独运行配置失败通常是没有库 launcher bootstrap；默认 buffer 未失效是复制语义；Worker 是否重启取决于 restart 策略。需人工恢复时用 Host 的 restart / replace，并查看 list / get 的当前代次与退出信息。
用真实 Worker 执行函数，并明确区分拥有 Worker 与借入消息端口。最短入口见 README。

rows: 在真实 Worker 上执行任务并区分线程与进程
通过同一连接反向调用父端并消费 Worker 结果
未签名的 RPC 转移被拒绝后仍可使用原字节
Host 报告重启就绪后立即调用新 Worker
关闭借用通道后继续使用原生端口
真实原生转移后保留捕获字节并替换观察回调

blocks.text: 下面六个示例各自保存为一个 .ts 文件，用 Node 24 直接运行；self spawn 会再次执行该文件，必须保留 child guard。它们不依赖浏览器授权，也不证明 Electron 或 Web Worker 的退出能力。
PluginHost 只用于 Host 场景；utils 的 scheduler 用于两个底层通道场景。各例最后释放自己拥有的资源，借入端口由调用方另行关闭。

sections.id: 在真实-worker-上执行任务并区分线程与进程
sections.heading: 在真实 Worker 上执行任务并区分线程与进程

blocks.text: 计算需要移出主线程，但单看返回的数字，还不知道它在哪里执行。
同一入口重新执行时，若不先区分子线程，就会继续创建更多 Worker；只比较进程 id，也无法区分同一 Node 进程里的线程。
先等待 `isThreadChild()`，子端提供方法，父端从当前真实文件启动 Worker，并同时比较原生进程和线程标识。
本例的 spawn: true 重用当前入口；省略 self 使用自动生成的 thread 身份，省略 provide 时不暴露应用方法。provide.double 的 value 是数值参数，identity 返回真实 process.pid / threadId；TRemote 只描述对端方法。默认调用期限为 30000 ms，report 使用默认诊断输出。
输出：
输出为 `42`、`true`、`true`：结果正确，进程 id 相同，而原生线程 id 不同。
这证明任务运行在同一进程的真实 Node Worker 中，不代表进程级隔离；持有它的 Peer 仍要显式关闭 Worker。

sections.id: 通过同一连接反向调用父端并消费-worker-结果
sections.heading: 通过同一连接反向调用父端并消费 Worker 结果

blocks.text: Worker 既需要父端持有的操作，也要提供一串任务结果。
拆成多套 `postMessage` 路由，就得分别维护结果对应和清理；先收集整个序列，又会推迟读取其中的值。
父端提供方法，Worker 等待反向请求结果；序列方法返回异步生成器，由父端通过 `stream()` 消费，最后统一关闭所有者。
父端 provide.prefix 接收字符串，子端 label 等待反向 request，count 接收 limit 并返回异步生成器。stream 在消费时发送，3 是本例序列上界；未设置的来源、超时和关闭规则与上一例相同。
输出：
输出为 `主端:任务`、`1,2,3`：一个请求反向调用父端，流则提供三个值。
这是同一连接上的两个独立方法；流开始迭代时才执行发送，`notify` 完成也不表示提供方已经执行完成。

sections.id: 未签名的-rpc-转移被拒绝后仍可使用原字节
sections.heading: 未签名的 RPC 转移被拒绝后仍可使用原字节

blocks.text: Worker 会修改收到的输入，但调用方后续还要使用自己的原始字节。
把所有原生端口发送都当成转移所有权，会意外让原存储失效；未配置签名的 RPC 转移也不能悄悄绕过信任边界。
先用默认复制方式请求，再尝试未配置认证的转移，并检查错误、原始存储和提供方调用次数。
inspect 接收 ArrayBuffer，修改自己的副本；calls 返回实际执行次数。request 最后的 transfer 数组请求转移该 backing；默认没有 authentication，因此拒绝前不 detach，不会调用第二次 inspect。默认复制不需要签名；已签名转移的部署规则见后文。
输出：
输出依次为 `3 7`、`3 7`、`CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED`、`3 1`：Worker 只修改了副本，被拒绝的转移既未让原存储失效，也未再次调用提供方。
已签名的 RPC 转移需要双方真实认证配置及协商后的原生能力；此例有意保留默认禁用状态。

sections.id: host-报告重启就绪后立即调用新-worker
sections.heading: Host 报告重启就绪后立即调用新 Worker

blocks.text: Host 重启 Worker 后，下一次请求需要到达新代次，而不是已经退役的实例。
只收到原生重启结果，并不一定说明应用目录已更新；随意增加延时，又会掩盖真正的就绪边界。
把带名称的线程插件安装到真实 Host，等待出口的重启结果后立刻再次读取计数器，不插入固定等待。

插件 name 必填，这里为 worker；spawn: true 使用当前入口。Host execution.mutationTimeoutMs 与 pipelineDrainTimeoutMs 均必填，false 表示不设预算，不是省略默认值。expose 缺省为空数组；restart 的 ready 是应用目录已更新后的结果，dispose 返回包含 cleanupComplete 的清理结果。
输出：
输出为 `1`、`ready`、`1`、`true`：新 Worker 的计数器重新开始，能够立即接收调用，Host 清理也已完成。
Host 拥有安装后的 Worker；两个必填执行预算显式设为 `false`，表示不设期限；重启不会迁移旧 Worker 的内存状态。

sections.id: 关闭借用通道后继续使用原生端口
sections.heading: 关闭借用通道后继续使用原生端口

blocks.text: 组件停止使用已有 MessagePort 时，调用方仍可能拥有这个物理端口。
适配器清理时直接关闭原生端口，会破坏调用方剩余的协议或其他显式管理的用途。
创建固定基础配置的 Node 通道，释放订阅并等待共享关闭结果，再用同一个原生端口发送消息。
createNodeThreadChannel 的 port 是借入的原生 MessagePort，peerId 是对端标签，options.scheduler 必填，本例直接使用 systemScheduler。capabilities 缺省走同步 static profile；subscribe 的返回值只退订该监听，close 复用关闭 Promise，不接管原生 port。
输出：

blocks.code:
static true
true
端口仍可用

blocks.text: 输出为 `static true`、`true`、`端口仍可用`：固定配置保留调度器，关闭复用同一个 Promise，原生端口之后仍能交付消息。
这是借用的底层通道，并非拥有 Worker 的启动所有者；最后仍由调用方关闭两个端口，省略 capabilities 不执行运行时扩展能力的双边确认。

sections.id: 真实原生转移后保留捕获字节并替换观察回调
sections.heading: 真实原生转移后保留捕获字节并替换观察回调

blocks.text: 诊断工具需要保留转移的字节，即使原生发送已经让调用方的原始 buffer 失效。
只保留失效后的引用，就会丢掉字节；若不区分代次，旧退订函数还可能错误移除新的观察回调。
观察真实 Node 载体，替换回调后执行旧 disposer，再通过两个真实 MessagePort 转移字节，最后停止当前观察回调。

observe 的 capturing 默认不要求内容；本例显式 false / true 切换。emit 按 direction、sizeBytes、carrier、detail、content 接收事件；send 的 transfer 是底层原生端口转移列表。subscribe 收到的 message.data 是载体值；这不是 RPC request，也不建立认证信任。utils 是此例直接导入的依赖，需直接安装。
输出：
输出依次为 `0`、`7,9`、`7,9`、`0 1`、`42 1`：原存储失效，实际接收与捕获字节一致，旧 disposer 不移除新观察回调，停止后不再捕获下一条消息。
这证明物理载体转移，不代表已签名的 RPC 准入；捕获已转移字节需要复制，不能据此声称全链路没有分配或速度更快。
本包创建 Worker、接入消息端口，并把 Worker 的预算、启动、重启和释放交给监督器。调用关联、目录、超时、取消、错误还原和重试归 Core；协议与便携值归 Contract。它适合把解析、压缩、图像处理等计算移出主线程，以及让 Host 统一管理多条 Worker 连接。

线程共享进程，不能代替独立进程的权限或故障隔离。需要独立进程时使用 rpc-process；跨窗口、iframe、SharedWorker、可靠有序 RTCDataChannel 的 Peer 使用 rpc-browser，Service Worker 和 BroadcastChannel 使用该包的 Endpoint transport。SharedArrayBuffer / Atomics 共享内存不在本包支持范围内。

rows: Peer、Plugin、child guard、错误码、高级通道与 Web launcher，以及公开配置和 handle 类型。

blocks.text: 直接安装 Core 与 Contract 两个 peer 依赖；不以硬编码版本相等作为运行时规则。lifecycle、supervision、utils 是运行时依赖。Electron-main 入口另需可选 peer `electron: ^44.0.0`。示例直接导入 PluginHost 或 utils 时，也应直接安装相应包。

Web、Bun、Deno 和 Electron renderer 使用根入口的 `createWebThreadLauncher`、`createWebThreadChannelFactory`。`INodeThreadHandle`、`IWebThreadHandle`、`IWebThreadLauncherOptions` 和高级原生运行时类型从根入口导入。根入口还重新导出 Core 的 typed surface、查询、详情、列表、事件与 thread stop 类型；这些不是另一套调用协议。

`createThreadPeer<TRemote>(options, runtime?)` 返回 typed Peer。`TRemote` 默认 `Record<never, never>`，只约束调用端类型，不注册 Worker 方法。`IRuntimeDynamicSurface` 可以放宽静态路径检查，运行时仍以对端真实目录为准。默认本地身份为 `{ name: 'thread', instanceId: 自动生成值 }`；需要稳定地址时显式传 `self.name`、`self.instanceId`。

主线程可以指定短 `spawn`、完整 `spawn` 或 Core 的 `connect` / `listen` 来源；来源不能混用。库 launcher 创建的 Worker 内省略来源，由真实 Node parentPort / workerData 或 Web Worker bootstrap 自动连接父线程。单独执行普通 Worker 文件不会获得这种连接。`isThreadChild()` 只读取库的启动标记以区分父子分支，不为外部 Worker 授权，也不替代能力确认。
`provide` 缺省不暴露应用方法；自身可枚举数据属性中的函数形成方法，嵌套对象形成点分路径，不接受 accessor 作为方法声明。返回 iterable / async iterable 的方法通过 `stream` 调用。Worker 端也是 Peer，可反向调用父线程的 `provide`。

rows: 等待一次结果，参数形式由真实目录与 typed surface 约束。
单向调用，不提供业务执行完成回执。
逐项消费远端 iterable / async iterable；取消仍依赖远端配合。
复用 Core 的分组、结果对账、目录和事件规则。
调用方释放独立 Peer；spawn 来源还释放它拥有的 Worker，借用来源只释放连接。

blocks.text: `defaultTimeoutMs` 缺省 30000，必须是正有限值，只用于 request / stream。单次 `timeoutMs` 可为非负有限值或 `false`；0 表示立即到期，false 关闭该次期限。全局并发默认 256，每个对端 64，通过 `providerLimits.maxGlobal`、`providerLimits.maxPerPeer` 调整；超额以 `OVERLOADED` 拒绝，不执行该次 provider。设置 `spec.limits.callWallTimeMs` 会进一步压低调用期限。

`signal` 是协作取消，超时、取消或断线都不能证明 Worker 尚未执行。非幂等写入先用业务标识对账；已声明幂等且仍保留结果的调用可结合 `idempotencyKey` / `outcome(key)`，不能把任意重试当作只执行一次。`report` 缺省 Core 的默认诊断输出（通常为 console.error）；它接收后台失败。`probe`、`contract`、`authentication`、`endpointFactory`、`keyFactory`、`retryPort` 延续 Core 各自 owner 的契约。

sections.id: 短-spawn-入口解析与监督默认值
sections.heading: 短 spawn、入口解析与监督默认值

rows: 重新执行当前主入口的全部顶层代码；先 await child guard，把主线程副作用放在父分支。
Node / Bun / Deno 下相对主入口目录解析；绝对文件路径按文件 URL 编码。
entry 接受 true、URL、字符串，可覆盖下表字段。
未设置；相对 entry 默认以主入口为基准，显式模块 URL / URL 字符串可改基准，不通过堆栈猜调用模块。
未设置；传入 Worker spec。data 先经 normalizePortable 形成快照，失败在 Worker 构造前以 Core INVALID_CONFIG 拒绝并保留 cause。
systemScheduler；同一预算和默认 channel factory 使用它。
按真实运行时延迟加载；自定义 factory 必须使用同一个 scheduler。
先取 source.report，再取顶层 options.report，最后 Core 默认 reporter。
未设置；仅当 launcher 没有 enforced exit-observation 时，绑定补实际 Endpoint ping；显式 health 优先且保留引用。
未设置；顶层同名配置优先于 source 字段。

blocks.text: 短形式只是展开已有完整 source，不允许自报“已经协商”或“已经信任”。监督字段继续由 supervision 校验和执行：

rows: 未设置；可提供真实就绪检查。
省略相当于 mode 为 stay，保持 terminal；另可选 mode 为 cooldown 并提供 afterMs 后重新尝试，terminal 不是“永远无法恢复”。
未设置；绑定先在剩余预算内排空当前调用，再调用自定义钩子。

blocks.text: 默认 RPC health 使用 5000 ms 间隔、2000 ms 单次上限、连续 3 次失败策略。Endpoint 尚未绑定时由原准备期限管理，绑定后只探测该 handle 的真实 Endpoint。显式去掉 ping 却未提供自定义 health 会以 INVALID_CONFIG 拒绝；健康检查不会把 unsupported 原生退出能力变成 enforced。
Node / Bun self spawn 保留运行时 flags；显式不同入口会过滤父进程的 eval、print、测试控制参数，保留 loader 等运行时 flags。REPL、eval、单文件二进制、Electron 和测试运行器等没有可复用主入口时，self spawn 以 INVALID_CONFIG 拒绝，不猜入口；显式可用入口不受“不能 self spawn”的推断限制。

Node 24 可剥离 .ts 类型，但不把相对 `./x.js` 重定向为 `./x.ts`；Bun 支持此映射。含这种 specifier 的工程在 Node / Deno 下使用构建输出或合适 loader，解析错误保留原 cause。浏览器只接受明确 URL，不接受 true / 裸字符串；动态 Worker 构造也不能替代 bundler 的字面量源码发现。应提供预构建模块 URL，或在自定义构造器内保留字面量 Worker 构造。Deno Worker 仍需相应宿主权限。
`createThreadPlugin(options, runtime?)` 复用 Peer 来源、provide 与认证配置，另需 `name`，`expose` 缺省为空数组：不向 Worker 暴露 Host 应用方法。只有明确选中的 Host 路径可见。安装后由 Host 持有连接和 Worker，经 `host.thread` 操作；直接 Peer 则由创建者关闭。

`host.thread.request` / notify / stream / group / outcome 的第一参数是连接名或 `{ name, instanceId }`。list / get 查询连接及当前代次，broadcast 返回每个目标的独立结果，on / watch 复用 Core 事件目录。stop / kill / restart / replace 仅用于 spawn 来源；连接来源不能据此终止外部 Worker。线程 stop 只接受 `{ graceMs }`，出现 signal 字段（即便 undefined）也拒绝。
restart 返回 ready、replace 返回 replaced 时，新代次已经发布进调用目录，可以立即调用，不需额外等待事件或自行退避。替换不会把已发往旧代次的业务自动迁移到新代次。Host 的 execution.mutationTimeoutMs 和 pipelineDrainTimeoutMs 必须显式配置，false 表示不设该预算。

sections.id: 二进制复制-签名与转移
sections.heading: 二进制复制、签名与转移

rows: 默认按值复制，原 buffer 仍可用；Uint8Array 的 offset / length 得到保留。
必须实际协商原生二进制与 transfer 能力，并建立签名认证；不满足时 CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED。
不支持，调用准入时拒绝。

blocks.text: 要使用普通 factory 的签名原生二进制，在双方 `createThreadPeer` 配置 `authentication: { sign, verify }`；无需另建 Endpoint。`sign` 保护完整语义输入及 Core 为原生 backing 计算的摘要，`verify` 必须拒绝伪造签名。该 profile 签名但不加密，encodedType 使用默认 any。能力提案经实际端口双边确认，配置里的字符串不构成信任证据。
使用 HMAC 时，双方从各自部署配置读取同一个密钥；密钥不经 RPC 发送，也不进入日志。可由应用用 createHmac 对完整输入生成签名，verify 先检查签名长度再用 timingSafeEqual 校验，失败抛出认证错误。旧示例中的 RPC_SIGNING_KEY 是应用环境变量名，不是库自动提供的凭据。Node Worker 继承环境，应用应在加载读取密钥的模块前设置部署配置。
buffer 在消息真正提交到原生端口时失效，byteLength 变为 0，共享 backing 的所有 view 同时失效。之后即使对端拒绝签名或调用失败，也不能恢复原 buffer。带 transfer 的调用不自动重试，库不保留输入副本；确认业务结果后按需重新构造数据。这里描述原生转移机制，没有未经测量的速度保证。

`createNodeThreadChannel(port, peerId, options)` 借用 EventEmitter 端口，`createWebThreadChannel` 借用 EventTarget 端口；options.scheduler 必填。未传 capabilities 时使用固定基础 profile，同步返回且不做运行时 hello。固定子集只含 stream / batch 时也走同步固定路径；扩展能力提案返回 Promise，Core 在实际端口等待双边 ACK，缺失或错误 ACK 会拒绝，不能把单方声明当作完成协商。

在 Peer 的 connect callback 中把 `context.capabilities` 交给 channel，并让两端同时开始。context.self 是 Core 为本地准备的真实地址；peerId 表示对端连接。显式 capabilities 可缩小提案，不可扩大实际 launch offer、伪造协商或信任。逻辑 channel.close / Peer.close 解除自己的监听和 observer，不物理关闭借入端口；调用方最后关闭原生端口。固定 raw channel 不等于完整 runtime Peer。

完整 `IRuntimeThreadSpawn` 必填 spec、launcher、budget、scheduler、channelFactory、report；health、supervisor、keyFactory、retryPort 可省略。完整 source 不继承短形式的 isolation 覆盖：省略 supervisor.isolation 时由 supervision 默认 required 处理。spec.entry 是 Node 绝对路径 / file URL，Web 是绝对模块 URL；spec.name / data / limits 可省略。heapBytes 和 callWallTimeMs 是正限制：前者映射为 Node Worker 的 maxOldGenerationSizeMb，后者限制调用期限；不是进程总内存 / 总 CPU 限额。

termination / exit-observation / heap-limit 均 enforced，真实 exit 才结算 exited。
根入口的两个 Web 工厂
termination / exit-observation enforced，原生 Worker 的 close 事件结算 exited；heap-limit unsupported。

三项均 unsupported；terminate 请求不产生真实 exit 回执。

blocks.text: Web launcher 必填 report，可选 Worker 构造器（默认全局 Worker）和 runtimeApi；构造器接收 entry 与 `{ type: 'module', name }`。Node launcher options 默认空对象，可显式 execArgv / runtimeApi；高级 createAdapterNodeThreadLauncher 另接真实 runtime resource。工厂只在实际启动时获取宿主能力。Node 的 sampleUsage 为冷查询：可用时报告该 isolate 的 heap、CPU 微秒和 ELU，sharedPid 只是共享进程身份；缺少原生方法时字段缺席，退出后返回空对象，不拿整个父进程用量冒充线程用量。

handle.identity 含稳定 fingerprint，Node 另含创建时 threadId；handle.port 为实际消息资源，terminate 只请求停止，exited 表示退出，Web 还提供 prepared。Node 由原生 exit、Bun 由原生 Worker close 结算 exited；Deno、浏览器和 Electron renderer 的退出观察为 unsupported，强制回收立即报告 supervision EXIT_UNOBSERVABLE 并保留 abandoned budget lease，不等待 reapTimeoutMs，也不能提前把槽位当空闲。可观察退出超时仍报告 REAP_TIMEOUT；best-effort 准入诊断 CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED 不变。自定义 Node / Web handle 的 open(signal, { scheduler, capabilities? }) 打开对应代次；channel factory 与它使用同一 scheduler。

构造或打开失败时，launcher / 监督 owner 释放已取得监听和候选 Worker；主错误保持原对象或在 cause 链中，清理错误保留在 errors。Node Endpoint 构造失败会回收真实 Worker 和预算；Web 请求 terminate 仍不能补出退出证明。高级调用方若直接 launch，须负责逻辑 channel 关闭、terminate 请求和等待真实 exited 的边界，不能在缺少原生回执的 Web 路径无限 await exited。

AdapterNodeThreadParentChannel 在构造时只保留真实 parentPort，open 才建立固定 profile，不先添加 listener。createAdapterNodeThreadPeer 接收已持有 parentPort 和原始 workerData；runtime resource 的 load 获取真实 Worker 模块，pid 表示共享进程。receiveThreadData 只消费匹配的初始 bootstrap，移除自己的 listener，await prepare(data, peerId) 后发送 ready；返回便携业务 data。readThreadBootstrap 校验并拆出 peerId / data；这些工具不给任意外部 Worker 授权。
新适配器复用 Core adapter SDK 的 defineMessageAdapter；复杂原生组装可使用它的 internal-advanced 入口，不复制能力协商、重试或生命周期 owner。Node Worker 与 Bun 1.4.3 原生 Worker 已有业务与关闭运行证据；这些结果不证明浏览器、Deno 或 Electron 的权限与退出能力。

最终 channel 的 `transport.observe(probe)` 安装物理消息观察；发送、接收各报告一次。发送 detail.transfers 为原生 transfer 列表长度，接收为 -1，因为 structured clone 不能说明收到的 buffer 是复制还是转移。直接 ArrayBuffer / view 的 sizeBytes 是字节长度，其它原生消息为 -1，不通过额外序列化估算对象大小。
仅 probe.capturing 开启时读取内容；未转移内容借用原引用，实际转移的 buffer 在发送前复制以保留观察字节。Core 对 own-data 原生容器的选择性捕获保留 Array、Record、Map、Set 中的环、共享 backing 和未转移对象引用；只经 accessor 返回转移 buffer 的情形不提供额外读取保证，不能为捕获再执行 getter。
probe 失败经 onListenerError 报 Core TRANSPORT，原异常保留在 cause，消息仍继续发送和接收。重复 observe 替换旧代，旧 disposer 不会移除新代；当前 disposer、逻辑 close 和既有原生 terminal 路径退休观察。借用端口 close 不改变物理端口所有权，也不改变既有监听与错误 cause 次序。

本包本地错误码对象 RpcThreadErrorCode 只有 usageSampleFailed，值为 THREAD_USAGE_SAMPLE_FAILED，RPC_THREAD_ERROR_SOURCE 为 @migaia/rpc/threads。调用、监督和 Host 边界各使用自己的 source，不把所有失败改成本包采样码。按 source / code 分支，不匹配 message 文本；业务异常跨 Worker 后保留原生类型、message、stack、source/code 与 cause / errors 链，不能承诺接收端对象与发送端同一 identity。
Worker 单独运行配置失败通常是没有库 launcher bootstrap；默认 buffer 未失效是复制语义；Worker 是否重启取决于 restart 策略。需人工恢复时用 Host 的 restart / replace，并查看 list / get 的当前代次与退出信息。
Run functions in real Workers and use one bidirectional request and stream API to manage results, restart, and closure.

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: A computation leaves the main code path, but a process-id check cannot show whether it reached a different thread.
A Worker needs parent methods and incremental results, so separate message routes duplicate correlation and cleanup.
Byte ownership becomes unclear when copying and transfer are treated as the same native send.
Requests after restart rely on arbitrary delays because native startup and application catalog readiness are confused.
Cleaning up one component closes a shared port because connection lifetime is mistaken for physical ownership.

Distinguish a real Worker from a separate process. Rather than checking only a result, the example compares native process and thread ids to establish another thread in the same process, as shown in the scenario.

Use one connection for reverse calls and result streams. Separate parent routes and sequence protocols are unnecessary here: the example independently returns a parent-produced label and three stream values, as shown in the scenario.

Keep caller bytes with default copying and reject unauthorized transfer. The example checks copy mutation, original storage, and provider call count rather than assuming a native port grants RPC transfer, as shown in the scenario.

Call immediately after the Host reports restart readiness. The example reads the fresh Worker counter immediately after ready instead of guessing catalog publication with a delay, as shown in the scenario.

Keep borrowed ports alive after logical closure. The example exchanges a native message after the shared close Promise settles, separating subscription cleanup from physical ownership, as shown in the scenario.

import { Worker } from 'node:worker_threads'

const source = `
  import { parentPort } from 'node:worker_threads'
  parentPort.on('message', (value) => parentPort.postMessage(value * 2))
`
const worker = new Worker(new URL('data:text/javascript,' + encodeURIComponent(source)))
worker.once('message', (value) => console.log(value)) // No request id to correlate concurrent results
worker.postMessage(21) // No call deadline or cancellation path
void worker // No final release; the Worker can remain alive

Browser entries need built module URLs. Install utils directly for the channel examples and PluginHost for the Host example:

blocks.text: This module creates Workers, connects their message ports, and delegates admission budgets, startup, restart, and release to supervision. Core owns call correlation, catalogs, deadlines, cancellation, error restoration, and retry; Contract owns the protocol and portable values. Use it to move parsing, compression, image processing, or similar work off the main thread, or to let a Host manage several Worker connections.

Threads share a process and do not replace separate process permissions or fault isolation. Use rpc-process for a separate process. rpc-browser provides Peers for windows, iframes, SharedWorkers, and reliable ordered RTCDataChannels, and Endpoint transports for Service Workers and BroadcastChannels. SharedArrayBuffer / Atomics shared memory is outside this module's supported profile.

rows: Peer, Plugin, child guard, error codes, advanced channels and Web launcher, plus public configuration and handle types.

blocks.text: Install both Core and Contract peer dependencies explicitly. The module does not enforce a hardcoded equality between their version numbers. lifecycle, supervision, and utils are runtime dependencies. The Electron-main entry additionally uses the optional peer `electron: ^44.0.0`. Install PluginHost or utils directly when an example imports them.

Web, Bun, Deno, and Electron renderer use the root Web launcher and channel factory. Import `INodeThreadHandle`, `IWebThreadHandle`, `IWebThreadLauncherOptions`, and advanced native runtime types from the root. Core's typed surfaces, query/detail/list/event types, and thread stop options are re-exported rather than defining another call protocol.

`createThreadPeer<TRemote>(options, runtime?)` returns a typed Peer. `TRemote` defaults to `Record<never, never>`; it checks the caller's paths without registering Worker methods. `IRuntimeDynamicSurface` relaxes static path checking while the actual remote catalog still controls runtime admission. The default local identity is `{ name: 'thread', instanceId: generated value }`; set self.name and self.instanceId for a stable address.

On the main thread, choose a short spawn, a full spawn source, or Core's connect / listen source; do not combine sources. Inside a Worker launched by this library, omit the source to connect through its real Node parentPort / workerData or Web bootstrap. Running an ordinary Worker file separately does not grant that connection. `isThreadChild()` reads the launch marker to choose a branch; it does not authorize an external Worker or replace capability acknowledgement.

Omitting provide exposes no application methods. Own enumerable data properties containing functions define methods; nested objects form dotted paths. Accessors are not method declarations. Call iterable / async iterable providers through stream. The Worker also receives a Peer and can request methods from its parent's provide descriptor.

rows: Await one result using the actual catalog and typed surface.
Send a one-way invocation without a receipt proving business completion.
Consume a remote iterable / async iterable incrementally; cancellation remains cooperative.
Use Core's group, result reconciliation, catalog, and event contracts.
The creator releases an independent Peer; spawn also releases its owned Worker, while a borrowed source releases only its connection.

blocks.text: defaultTimeoutMs defaults to 30000, must be positive and finite, and applies only to request / stream. Per-call timeoutMs accepts a nonnegative finite value or false: 0 expires immediately and false disables that deadline. Provider concurrency defaults to 256 globally and 64 per peer, configurable through providerLimits.maxGlobal and providerLimits.maxPerPeer. OVERLOADED rejects before running that provider. spec.limits.callWallTimeMs, when present, caps a longer call deadline.

signal requests cooperative cancellation. A timeout, cancellation, or disconnect does not prove the Worker did not execute. Reconcile non-idempotent writes using a business identifier. For declared idempotent calls with retained results, idempotencyKey and outcome(key) can help; arbitrary retries do not become exactly-once execution. report defaults to Core's diagnostic reporter, normally console.error. probe, contract, authentication, endpointFactory, keyFactory, and retryPort retain their Core-owned contracts.

sections.heading: Short spawn, entry resolution, and supervision defaults

rows: Re-execute every top-level statement in the main module; await the child guard and keep parent-only effects in the parent branch.
Resolve relative to the main module under Node / Bun / Deno; encode absolute filesystem paths as file URLs.
entry accepts true, URL, or string; the following fields override defaults.
Unset. Relative entries use the main module unless an explicit module URL / URL string changes the base; no stack inspection guesses the caller.
Unset; passed into the Worker spec. normalizePortable snapshots data before Worker construction; invalid data produces Core INVALID_CONFIG with its cause retained.
systemScheduler, shared by the budget and default channel factory.
Loaded lazily for the actual runtime; a custom factory must use the same scheduler.
source.report, then top-level options.report, then Core's default reporter.
Unset. Only launchers without enforced exit observation receive an actual Endpoint ping by default; explicit health takes precedence and retains its identity.
Short sources default to best-effort; accepted values are required and best-effort.
Unset; top-level fields take precedence over source fields.

blocks.text: Short syntax expands the existing full source. It accepts no declaration that negotiation or trust has already occurred. Supervision still validates and executes the following policy:

rows: Unset; may provide a real readiness check.
Omission behaves as mode stay, leaving the supervisor terminal; mode cooldown with afterMs permits another attempt later. Terminal does not mean explicit recovery is impossible.
Unset; the binding first drains current calls within the remaining budget, then invokes a custom hook.

blocks.text: The default RPC health policy uses a 5000 ms interval, a 2000 ms check budget, and 3 consecutive failures. The original preparation deadline governs an unbound Endpoint; a bound check addresses only the Endpoint for that actual handle. Removing ping without supplying custom health produces INVALID_CONFIG. A health check does not strengthen an unsupported native exit capability.

Node / Bun self spawn retains runtime flags. A different explicit entry filters the parent's eval, print, and test controller flags while retaining loader and runtime flags. Self spawn rejects with INVALID_CONFIG when a REPL, eval, single binary, Electron application, or test runner has no reusable main module. It does not guess an entry, nor does this rule prohibit an explicitly supplied usable entry.

Node 24 strips TypeScript types but does not redirect a relative ./x.js import to ./x.ts; Bun supports that mapping. Use built output or a suitable loader under Node / Deno for modules containing such specifiers; resolution failures retain the original cause. Browsers require an explicit URL and reject true / bare strings. Dynamic Worker construction also cannot replace a bundler's literal source discovery: supply a built module URL or keep the literal Worker construction in a custom constructor. Deno Workers still require the appropriate host permissions.

`createThreadPlugin(options, runtime?)` shares Peer sources, provide, and authentication. It additionally requires name. expose defaults to an empty array, exposing no Host application methods to the Worker; only explicitly selected paths are visible. The Host owns installed connections and Workers through host.thread, while the creator owns an independent Peer.

host.thread.request / notify / stream / group / outcome take a connection name or `{ name, instanceId }` first. list / get inspect connections and generations; broadcast returns an individual outcome per target; on / watch use Core's event catalog. stop / kill / restart / replace apply only to spawn sources and cannot terminate an external Worker behind a borrowed connection. Thread stop accepts only `{ graceMs }`; a signal field is rejected even when its value is undefined.

When restart returns ready or replace returns replaced, the new generation is already in the call catalog and may be called immediately. No extra ready event or application backoff is required. Replacement does not move calls already sent to the old generation. Host execution.mutationTimeoutMs and pipelineDrainTimeoutMs require explicit configuration; false disables the respective budget.

rows: Copied by default, leaving caller storage usable; Uint8Array offset / length are preserved.
Requires actual agreement on native binary and transfer, plus signing authentication; otherwise CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED.
Unsupported and rejected during call admission.

blocks.text: Configure authentication with sign and verify on both ordinary createThreadPeer factories to use signed native binary; a custom Endpoint is unnecessary. sign must protect the complete semantic input, including Core's integrity digest for native backing storage; verify must reject forged signatures. This profile signs without encryption and uses the default any encodedType. Actual ports acknowledge capability proposals; configuration labels do not establish trust.

For HMAC, both sides obtain the same key from their own deployment configuration. Never send it over RPC or log it. Application code can sign the complete input using createHmac, check the received signature length, then verify with timingSafeEqual and reject invalid authentication. RPC_SIGNING_KEY in the previous example is an application environment variable, not a credential supplied by the library. Node Workers inherit the environment; configure it before importing a module that reads the key.

Storage detaches when the message is physically submitted: byteLength becomes 0 and every view sharing its backing becomes unusable. A later signature rejection or failed call cannot restore it. Transfer calls are not automatically retried, and the library retains no input copy. Reconcile the business outcome before rebuilding data for a retry. This describes the native mechanism without making an unmeasured speed claim.

createNodeThreadChannel(port, peerId, options) borrows an EventEmitter port; createWebThreadChannel borrows an EventTarget port. options.scheduler is required. Omitted capabilities select the fixed baseline, return synchronously, and perform no runtime hello. Fixed subsets containing only stream / batch also use this synchronous path. Extension proposals return a Promise and wait for Core's bilateral ACK on the actual ports; missing or invalid ACK rejects rather than accepting a one-sided declaration.

In a Peer connect callback, pass context.capabilities to the channel and start both sides together. context.self is Core's prepared local address; peerId identifies the opposite connection. Explicit capabilities narrow the proposal and cannot expand a real launch offer or counterfeit agreement or trust. Logical channel.close / Peer.close removes its own listeners and observer without closing the borrowed native port. The caller closes that port last. A fixed raw channel is not a complete runtime Peer.

A full IRuntimeThreadSpawn requires spec, launcher, budget, scheduler, channelFactory, and report; health, supervisor, keyFactory, and retryPort are optional. It does not inherit the short syntax's isolation override: omitting supervisor.isolation leaves supervision's required default. spec.entry is a Node absolute path / file URL or a Web absolute module URL; spec.name / data / limits are optional. heapBytes and callWallTimeMs are positive limits. The former maps to Node Worker's maxOldGenerationSizeMb, while the latter caps a call deadline; neither is a whole-process memory or CPU quota.

rows: termination, exit-observation, and heap-limit are enforced; only a real exit settles exited.
termination and exit-observation are enforced; the native Worker close event settles exited. heap-limit remains unsupported.
All three are unsupported; a terminate request supplies no actual-exit receipt.
Reuse worker_threads but explicitly retain all three as unsupported; Node evidence is not Electron proof.

blocks.text: The Web launcher requires report and accepts a Worker constructor, defaulting to global Worker, plus optional runtimeApi. Its constructor receives entry and `{ type: 'module', name }`. Node launcher options default to an empty object and accept execArgv / runtimeApi; advanced createAdapterNodeThreadLauncher also takes a real runtime resource. Host capabilities are acquired only when a launch occurs. Node sampleUsage is a cold query for this isolate's available heap, CPU microseconds, and ELU. sharedPid is identity only; unavailable native methods leave fields absent, and an exited Worker returns an empty object rather than borrowing parent-process totals.

handle.identity contains a stable fingerprint and, on Node, the threadId captured at construction. handle.port holds real messaging; terminate requests stopping; exited observes exit; Web also exposes prepared. Node settles exited from native exit and Bun from native Worker close. Deno, browsers and Electron renderer declare exit observation unsupported: forced reap immediately reports supervision EXIT_UNOBSERVABLE and retains an abandoned budget lease without waiting for reapTimeoutMs or falsely freeing admission capacity. Observable exit timeouts still report REAP_TIMEOUT; best-effort admission still reports CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED. Custom Node / Web handles open a generation with open(signal, { scheduler, capabilities? }); the factory must share its scheduler.

When construction or opening fails, launcher / supervision ownership releases acquired listeners and the candidate Worker. The primary exception stays identical or reachable through cause, with cleanup failures retained in errors. A Node Endpoint construction failure reaps the real Worker and frees its budget. A Web terminate request still cannot manufacture exit proof. Advanced callers that launch directly own logical channel closure, termination, and actual-exit observation; do not await Web exited forever when the platform supplies no receipt.

AdapterNodeThreadParentChannel retains the real parentPort without adding listeners until open selects the fixed profile. createAdapterNodeThreadPeer receives an already held parentPort and original workerData. A runtime resource loads the real Worker module; its pid identifies the shared process. receiveThreadData consumes the matching initial bootstrap, removes its listener, awaits prepare(data, peerId), sends ready, and returns portable business data. readThreadBootstrap validates and extracts peerId / data. These helpers do not authorize arbitrary external Workers.

New adapters reuse defineMessageAdapter from the Core adapter SDK; complex native assembly may use its internal-advanced entry without duplicating capability negotiation, retries, or lifecycle ownership. Node Workers and Bun 1.4.3 native Workers have business and shutdown evidence; these results do not establish browser, Deno, or Electron permissions and exit capabilities.

transport.observe(probe) on the final channel installs physical message observation, with one event per send and receive. Outbound detail.transfers is the native transfer-list length; inbound is -1 because structured clone does not reveal whether a received buffer was copied or transferred. sizeBytes is the byte length for a direct ArrayBuffer / view and -1 for other native messages, without additional object serialization.

Content is read only when probe.capturing is enabled. Non-transferred content borrows the original reference; transferred backing is copied before sending to preserve observable bytes. Core's selective own-data capture preserves cycles, shared backing, and non-transferred references inside Array, Record, Map, and Set. No additional getter evaluation is promised for transferred buffers exposed only through accessors.

Probe failures report Core TRANSPORT through onListenerError with the original exception on cause, while messaging continues. Reinstalling observe replaces its generation; an old disposer cannot remove the new one. The current disposer, logical close, and existing native terminal path retire observation. Closing a borrowed channel changes neither physical port ownership nor the existing listener and error-cause ordering.

The table distinguishes thread sampling, supervision, Core and Remote errors. Import thread APIs from `@migaia/rpc-threads`, Core APIs from `@migaia/rpc-core`, and Remote APIs from `@migaia/rpc-core/remote`; each `source` value retains its error identity.

rows: Thread CPU / memory sampling failed, with cause retained; display unavailable without changing Worker lifecycle.
Exit observation is explicitly unsupported; immediate abandonment retains the lease without a reap wait.
Invalid entry, source, bootstrap, capability ACK, portable data, or configuration; inspect field details and cause.
Native message I/O or startup resource failure, preserving native error type and cause.
TimeoutError; the Worker may already have executed, so reconcile first.
AbortError; cooperative cancellation does not prove non-execution.
Provider concurrency was full and that provider was not called; reduce load before retrying.
A required capability was not agreed, such as unsigned transfer.
No current catalog target; check its name and active generation.
Connection or generation is closed; select a current target and reconcile previously sent work.

blocks.text: When native Node Worker construction rejects its arguments, the Node launcher classifies the failure as Core INVALID_CONFIG. If a native code already exists, a wrapper keeps the original Error, name, message, stack, and native code on cause rather than overwriting them. This describes the Node constructor boundary, not every Web constructor exception.

The local RpcThreadErrorCode object contains only usageSampleFailed, whose value is THREAD_USAGE_SAMPLE_FAILED; RPC_THREAD_ERROR_SOURCE is `@migaia/rpc/threads`. Calls, supervision, and Host boundaries retain their own sources rather than becoming sampling failures. Branch on source / code rather than message text. Business errors crossing Workers preserve native type, message, stack, source/code, and cause / errors chains; the received object cannot retain sender-side identity.

A standalone Worker configuration failure usually means no library bootstrap exists. A caller buffer that remains attached is the default copy behavior. Restart depends on policy; use Host restart / replace for explicit recovery and list / get for generation and exit information.

blocks.text: Save each complete example as its own .ts file and run it with Node 24. Self spawn re-executes that file, so retain the child guard. These examples require no browser authorization and do not establish Electron or Web Worker exit capabilities.
PluginHost is used by the Host scenario; utils supplies the scheduler for the two channel scenarios. Each example releases its owned resources, and the caller closes borrowed native ports separately.

sections.heading: Run work on a real Worker without confusing it with another process

blocks.text: CPU work should leave the main thread, but a returned number does not identify where it ran.
Reexecuting the same entry without a child branch creates more Workers, while checking only process ids cannot distinguish threads of one Node process.
Await isThreadChild(), provide methods in the Worker, and spawn the real current file; compare both native process and thread identities.

spawn: true reuses the current entry. Omitted self uses a generated thread identity; omitted provide exposes no application methods. provide.double takes a number and identity returns native process.pid / threadId. TRemote describes remote methods only. The default call deadline is 30000 ms and report uses the default diagnostic output.
Output:
Output is `42`, `true`, `true`: the result is correct, process ids match, and native thread ids differ.
This proves a real Node Worker within one process; it does not provide process isolation, and the owning Peer must close the Worker explicitly.

sections.heading: Call the parent and consume Worker results through one connection

blocks.text: A Worker needs a parent-owned operation while also exposing a sequence of task results.
Separate postMessage routes require their own correlation and cleanup, and collecting the whole sequence delays access to its individual values.
Provide the parent method, await its request from the Worker, and expose an async generator for stream(); the parent closes one owner afterward.

The parent's provide.prefix accepts a string. The Worker's label awaits the reverse request, while count takes limit and returns an async generator. The stream sends when consumed; 3 bounds this sequence. Unset source, deadline, and close rules are unchanged from the first example.
Output:
Output is `main:job` and `1,2,3`: one request crosses back to the parent and the stream supplies three values.
These are separate methods on the same connection; streams are lazy until iteration, and notify completion would not acknowledge provider completion.

sections.heading: Keep copied bytes usable when unsigned RPC transfer is refused

blocks.text: A Worker mutates its input, but the caller still needs its original bytes for later work.
Assuming every native port send transfers ownership can detach storage unexpectedly; requesting RPC transfer without its trust configuration must not silently bypass that boundary.
Use the default copying request, then attempt transfer without authentication and check the error, original storage and provider call count.

inspect accepts an ArrayBuffer and changes its own copy; calls reports actual executions. The final request option requests transfer of that backing. Authentication is absent, so rejection occurs before detachment or a second inspect invocation. Default copying needs no signature; signed-transfer deployment is described below.
Output:
Output is `3 7`, `3 7`, `CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED`, then `3 1`: the Worker changed only its copy, and rejected transfer neither detached the original nor invoked it again.
Signed RPC transfer requires both endpoints' real authentication configuration and negotiated native capabilities; this example intentionally leaves it disabled.

sections.heading: Call a restarted Worker as soon as its Host reports ready

blocks.text: A Host restarts a Worker, and the next request must reach the fresh generation rather than a retired instance.
A native restart result alone may not mean an application directory has rebound; adding arbitrary delays obscures that boundary.
Install a named thread plugin in a real Host, await its restart result, and immediately call its counter again without a sleep.

The plugin requires name, here worker; spawn: true uses the current entry. Both Host execution.mutationTimeoutMs and pipelineDrainTimeoutMs are required. false explicitly disables those budgets rather than selecting an omitted default. expose defaults to an empty array. restart reports ready after catalog publication; dispose returns a cleanup result containing cleanupComplete.
Output:
Output is `1`, `ready`, `1`, then `true`: the fresh Worker starts its counter again, accepts an immediate call, and Host cleanup completes.
The Host owns the installed Worker; both required execution budgets are explicitly false for no deadline, and restart does not migrate the old Worker's in-memory state.

sections.heading: Close a borrowed channel while keeping its native port usable

blocks.text: A component stops using an existing MessagePort, but its caller still owns that physical port.
Unconditionally closing the port during adapter cleanup can break the caller's remaining protocol or another explicitly managed use.
Construct a fixed-profile Node channel, release its subscription and shared close result, then send a native message through the same held port.

createNodeThreadChannel borrows a native MessagePort. peerId labels its opposite connection, and options.scheduler is required; this example passes systemScheduler directly. Omitted capabilities select the synchronous static profile. subscribe returns a subscription disposer, and close shares its Promise without owning the native port.
Output:
Output is `static true`, `true`, then `still open`: fixed construction preserves the scheduler, close shares its Promise, and the native port still delivers afterward.
This is a borrowed low-level channel, not a spawned Worker owner; the caller finally closes both ports, and omitted capabilities do not perform runtime-extension ACK.

sections.heading: Retain captured bytes across a real native transfer and observer replacement

blocks.text: A diagnostics tool must retain transferred bytes even after native sending detaches the caller's original buffer.
Keeping only the detached reference loses those bytes, while an old unsubscribe can accidentally remove a replacement observer if generations are not distinguished.
Observe the actual Node carrier, replace its observer, invoke the old disposer, and transfer through two real MessagePorts before stopping the current observer.

capturing controls whether observation includes content; the example explicitly uses false and true. emit receives direction, sizeBytes, carrier, detail, and content. send.transfer is a native carrier transfer list. subscribe receives the carrier value as message.data. This is not an RPC request or an authentication agreement. Install utils directly because this example imports it.
Output:
Output is `0`, `7,9`, `7,9`, `0 1`, then `42 1`: storage detaches, delivery and captured bytes agree, the old disposer leaves the new observer active, and stopping it prevents another capture.
This is physical carrier transfer, not signed RPC admission; captured transferred bytes require a copy, and no end-to-end allocation or speed claim follows.

This module creates Workers, connects their message ports, and delegates admission budgets, startup, restart, and release to supervision. Core owns call correlation, catalogs, deadlines, cancellation, error restoration, and retry; Contract owns the protocol and portable values. Use it to move parsing, compression, image processing, or similar work off the main thread, or to let a Host manage several Worker connections.

Threads share a process and do not replace separate process permissions or fault isolation. Use rpc-process for a separate process. rpc-browser provides Peers for windows, iframes, SharedWorkers, and reliable ordered RTCDataChannels, and Endpoint transports for Service Workers and BroadcastChannels. SharedArrayBuffer / Atomics shared memory is outside this module's supported profile.

rows: Peer, Plugin, child guard, error codes, advanced channels and Web launcher, plus public configuration and handle types.

blocks.text: Install both Core and Contract peer dependencies explicitly. The module does not enforce a hardcoded equality between their version numbers. lifecycle, supervision, and utils are runtime dependencies. The Electron-main entry additionally uses the optional peer `electron: ^44.0.0`. Install PluginHost or utils directly when an example imports them.

Web, Bun, Deno, and Electron renderer use the root Web launcher and channel factory. Import `INodeThreadHandle`, `IWebThreadHandle`, `IWebThreadLauncherOptions`, and advanced native runtime types from the root. Core's typed surfaces, query/detail/list/event types, and thread stop options are re-exported rather than defining another call protocol.

`createThreadPeer<TRemote>(options, runtime?)` returns a typed Peer. `TRemote` defaults to `Record<never, never>`; it checks the caller's paths without registering Worker methods. `IRuntimeDynamicSurface` relaxes static path checking while the actual remote catalog still controls runtime admission. The default local identity is `{ name: 'thread', instanceId: generated value }`; set self.name and self.instanceId for a stable address.

On the main thread, choose a short spawn, a full spawn source, or Core's connect / listen source; do not combine sources. Inside a Worker launched by this library, omit the source to connect through its real Node parentPort / workerData or Web bootstrap. Running an ordinary Worker file separately does not grant that connection. `isThreadChild()` reads the launch marker to choose a branch; it does not authorize an external Worker or replace capability acknowledgement.

Omitting provide exposes no application methods. Own enumerable data properties containing functions define methods; nested objects form dotted paths. Accessors are not method declarations. Call iterable / async iterable providers through stream. The Worker also receives a Peer and can request methods from its parent's provide descriptor.

rows: Await one result using the actual catalog and typed surface.
Send a one-way invocation without a receipt proving business completion.
Consume a remote iterable / async iterable incrementally; cancellation remains cooperative.
Use Core's group, result reconciliation, catalog, and event contracts.
The creator releases an independent Peer; spawn also releases its owned Worker, while a borrowed source releases only its connection.

blocks.text: defaultTimeoutMs defaults to 30000, must be positive and finite, and applies only to request / stream. Per-call timeoutMs accepts a nonnegative finite value or false: 0 expires immediately and false disables that deadline. Provider concurrency defaults to 256 globally and 64 per peer, configurable through providerLimits.maxGlobal and providerLimits.maxPerPeer. OVERLOADED rejects before running that provider. spec.limits.callWallTimeMs, when present, caps a longer call deadline.

signal requests cooperative cancellation. A timeout, cancellation, or disconnect does not prove the Worker did not execute. Reconcile non-idempotent writes using a business identifier. For declared idempotent calls with retained results, idempotencyKey and outcome(key) can help; arbitrary retries do not become exactly-once execution. report defaults to Core's diagnostic reporter, normally console.error. probe, contract, authentication, endpointFactory, keyFactory, and retryPort retain their Core-owned contracts.

sections.heading: Short spawn, entry resolution, and supervision defaults

rows: Re-execute every top-level statement in the main module; await the child guard and keep parent-only effects in the parent branch.
Resolve relative to the main module under Node / Bun / Deno; encode absolute filesystem paths as file URLs.
entry accepts true, URL, or string; the following fields override defaults.
Unset. Relative entries use the main module unless an explicit module URL / URL string changes the base; no stack inspection guesses the caller.
Unset; passed into the Worker spec. normalizePortable snapshots data before Worker construction; invalid data produces Core INVALID_CONFIG with its cause retained.
systemScheduler, shared by the budget and default channel factory.
Loaded lazily for the actual runtime; a custom factory must use the same scheduler.
source.report, then top-level options.report, then Core's default reporter.
Unset. Only launchers without enforced exit observation receive an actual Endpoint ping by default; explicit health takes precedence and retains its identity.
Short sources default to best-effort; accepted values are required and best-effort.
Unset; top-level fields take precedence over source fields.

blocks.text: Short syntax expands the existing full source. It accepts no declaration that negotiation or trust has already occurred. Supervision still validates and executes the following policy:

rows: Unset; may provide a real readiness check.
Omission behaves as mode stay, leaving the supervisor terminal; mode cooldown with afterMs permits another attempt later. Terminal does not mean explicit recovery is impossible.
Unset; the binding first drains current calls within the remaining budget, then invokes a custom hook.

blocks.text: The default RPC health policy uses a 5000 ms interval, a 2000 ms check budget, and 3 consecutive failures. The original preparation deadline governs an unbound Endpoint; a bound check addresses only the Endpoint for that actual handle. Removing ping without supplying custom health produces INVALID_CONFIG. A health check does not strengthen an unsupported native exit capability.

Node / Bun self spawn retains runtime flags. A different explicit entry filters the parent's eval, print, and test controller flags while retaining loader and runtime flags. Self spawn rejects with INVALID_CONFIG when a REPL, eval, single binary, Electron application, or test runner has no reusable main module. It does not guess an entry, nor does this rule prohibit an explicitly supplied usable entry.

Node 24 strips TypeScript types but does not redirect a relative ./x.js import to ./x.ts; Bun supports that mapping. Use built output or a suitable loader under Node / Deno for modules containing such specifiers; resolution failures retain the original cause. Browsers require an explicit URL and reject true / bare strings. Dynamic Worker construction also cannot replace a bundler's literal source discovery: supply a built module URL or keep the literal Worker construction in a custom constructor. Deno Workers still require the appropriate host permissions.

`createThreadPlugin(options, runtime?)` shares Peer sources, provide, and authentication. It additionally requires name. expose defaults to an empty array, exposing no Host application methods to the Worker; only explicitly selected paths are visible. The Host owns installed connections and Workers through host.thread, while the creator owns an independent Peer.

host.thread.request / notify / stream / group / outcome take a connection name or `{ name, instanceId }` first. list / get inspect connections and generations; broadcast returns an individual outcome per target; on / watch use Core's event catalog. stop / kill / restart / replace apply only to spawn sources and cannot terminate an external Worker behind a borrowed connection. Thread stop accepts only `{ graceMs }`; a signal field is rejected even when its value is undefined.

When restart returns ready or replace returns replaced, the new generation is already in the call catalog and may be called immediately. No extra ready event or application backoff is required. Replacement does not move calls already sent to the old generation. Host execution.mutationTimeoutMs and pipelineDrainTimeoutMs require explicit configuration; false disables the respective budget.

rows: Copied by default, leaving caller storage usable; Uint8Array offset / length are preserved.
Requires actual agreement on native binary and transfer, plus signing authentication; otherwise CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED.
Unsupported and rejected during call admission.

blocks.text: Configure authentication with sign and verify on both ordinary createThreadPeer factories to use signed native binary; a custom Endpoint is unnecessary. sign must protect the complete semantic input, including Core's integrity digest for native backing storage; verify must reject forged signatures. This profile signs without encryption and uses the default any encodedType. Actual ports acknowledge capability proposals; configuration labels do not establish trust.

For HMAC, both sides obtain the same key from their own deployment configuration. Never send it over RPC or log it. Application code can sign the complete input using createHmac, check the received signature length, then verify with timingSafeEqual and reject invalid authentication. RPC_SIGNING_KEY in the previous example is an application environment variable, not a credential supplied by the library. Node Workers inherit the environment; configure it before importing a module that reads the key.

Storage detaches when the message is physically submitted: byteLength becomes 0 and every view sharing its backing becomes unusable. A later signature rejection or failed call cannot restore it. Transfer calls are not automatically retried, and the library retains no input copy. Reconcile the business outcome before rebuilding data for a retry. This describes the native mechanism without making an unmeasured speed claim.

createNodeThreadChannel(port, peerId, options) borrows an EventEmitter port; createWebThreadChannel borrows an EventTarget port. options.scheduler is required. Omitted capabilities select the fixed baseline, return synchronously, and perform no runtime hello. Fixed subsets containing only stream / batch also use this synchronous path. Extension proposals return a Promise and wait for Core's bilateral ACK on the actual ports; missing or invalid ACK rejects rather than accepting a one-sided declaration.

In a Peer connect callback, pass context.capabilities to the channel and start both sides together. context.self is Core's prepared local address; peerId identifies the opposite connection. Explicit capabilities narrow the proposal and cannot expand a real launch offer or counterfeit agreement or trust. Logical channel.close / Peer.close removes its own listeners and observer without closing the borrowed native port. The caller closes that port last. A fixed raw channel is not a complete runtime Peer.

A full IRuntimeThreadSpawn requires spec, launcher, budget, scheduler, channelFactory, and report; health, supervisor, keyFactory, and retryPort are optional. It does not inherit the short syntax's isolation override: omitting supervisor.isolation leaves supervision's required default. spec.entry is a Node absolute path / file URL or a Web absolute module URL; spec.name / data / limits are optional. heapBytes and callWallTimeMs are positive limits. The former maps to Node Worker's maxOldGenerationSizeMb, while the latter caps a call deadline; neither is a whole-process memory or CPU quota.

rows: termination, exit-observation, and heap-limit are enforced; only a real exit settles exited.
termination and exit-observation are enforced; the native Worker close event settles exited. heap-limit remains unsupported.
All three are unsupported; a terminate request supplies no actual-exit receipt.
Reuse worker_threads but explicitly retain all three as unsupported; Node evidence is not Electron proof.

blocks.text: The Web launcher requires report and accepts a Worker constructor, defaulting to global Worker, plus optional runtimeApi. Its constructor receives entry and `{ type: 'module', name }`. Node launcher options default to an empty object and accept execArgv / runtimeApi; advanced createAdapterNodeThreadLauncher also takes a real runtime resource. Host capabilities are acquired only when a launch occurs. Node sampleUsage is a cold query for this isolate's available heap, CPU microseconds, and ELU. sharedPid is identity only; unavailable native methods leave fields absent, and an exited Worker returns an empty object rather than borrowing parent-process totals.

handle.identity contains a stable fingerprint and, on Node, the threadId captured at construction. handle.port holds real messaging; terminate requests stopping; exited observes exit; Web also exposes prepared. Node settles exited from native exit and Bun from native Worker close. Deno, browsers and Electron renderer declare exit observation unsupported: forced reap immediately reports supervision EXIT_UNOBSERVABLE and retains an abandoned budget lease without waiting for reapTimeoutMs or falsely freeing admission capacity. Observable exit timeouts still report REAP_TIMEOUT; best-effort admission still reports CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED. Custom Node / Web handles open a generation with open(signal, { scheduler, capabilities? }); the factory must share its scheduler.

When construction or opening fails, launcher / supervision ownership releases acquired listeners and the candidate Worker. The primary exception stays identical or reachable through cause, with cleanup failures retained in errors. A Node Endpoint construction failure reaps the real Worker and frees its budget. A Web terminate request still cannot manufacture exit proof. Advanced callers that launch directly own logical channel closure, termination, and actual-exit observation; do not await Web exited forever when the platform supplies no receipt.

AdapterNodeThreadParentChannel retains the real parentPort without adding listeners until open selects the fixed profile. createAdapterNodeThreadPeer receives an already held parentPort and original workerData. A runtime resource loads the real Worker module; its pid identifies the shared process. receiveThreadData consumes the matching initial bootstrap, removes its listener, awaits prepare(data, peerId), sends ready, and returns portable business data. readThreadBootstrap validates and extracts peerId / data. These helpers do not authorize arbitrary external Workers.

New adapters reuse defineMessageAdapter from the Core adapter SDK; complex native assembly may use its internal-advanced entry without duplicating capability negotiation, retries, or lifecycle ownership. Node Workers and Bun 1.4.3 native Workers have business and shutdown evidence; these results do not establish browser, Deno, or Electron permissions and exit capabilities.

transport.observe(probe) on the final channel installs physical message observation, with one event per send and receive. Outbound detail.transfers is the native transfer-list length; inbound is -1 because structured clone does not reveal whether a received buffer was copied or transferred. sizeBytes is the byte length for a direct ArrayBuffer / view and -1 for other native messages, without additional object serialization.

Content is read only when probe.capturing is enabled. Non-transferred content borrows the original reference; transferred backing is copied before sending to preserve observable bytes. Core's selective own-data capture preserves cycles, shared backing, and non-transferred references inside Array, Record, Map, and Set. No additional getter evaluation is promised for transferred buffers exposed only through accessors.

Probe failures report Core TRANSPORT through onListenerError with the original exception on cause, while messaging continues. Reinstalling observe replaces its generation; an old disposer cannot remove the new one. The current disposer, logical close, and existing native terminal path retire observation. Closing a borrowed channel changes neither physical port ownership nor the existing listener and error-cause ordering.

rows: Thread CPU / memory sampling failed, with cause retained; display unavailable without changing Worker lifecycle.
Exit observation is explicitly unsupported; immediate abandonment retains the lease without a reap wait.
Invalid entry, source, bootstrap, capability ACK, portable data, or configuration; inspect field details and cause.
Native message I/O or startup resource failure, preserving native error type and cause.
TimeoutError; the Worker may already have executed, so reconcile first.
AbortError; cooperative cancellation does not prove non-execution.
Provider concurrency was full and that provider was not called; reduce load before retrying.
A required capability was not agreed, such as unsigned transfer.
No current catalog target; check its name and active generation.
Connection or generation is closed; select a current target and reconcile previously sent work.

blocks.text: When native Node Worker construction rejects its arguments, the Node launcher classifies the failure as Core INVALID_CONFIG. If a native code already exists, a wrapper keeps the original Error, name, message, stack, and native code on cause rather than overwriting them. This describes the Node constructor boundary, not every Web constructor exception.

The local RpcThreadErrorCode object contains only usageSampleFailed, whose value is THREAD_USAGE_SAMPLE_FAILED; RPC_THREAD_ERROR_SOURCE is @migaia/rpc/threads. Calls, supervision, and Host boundaries retain their own sources rather than becoming sampling failures. Branch on source / code rather than message text. Business errors crossing Workers preserve native type, message, stack, source/code, and cause / errors chains; the received object cannot retain sender-side identity.

A standalone Worker configuration failure usually means no library bootstrap exists. A caller buffer that remains attached is the default copy behavior. Restart depends on policy; use Host restart / replace for explicit recovery and list / get for generation and exit information.

symbols.purpose: Worker side, advanced: builds the Peer from a `parentPort` and `workerData` you hold yourself instead of reading the module globals.
symbols.core:
options: Peer options; see `IRuntimeThreadPeerOptions`.
parentPort: `parentPort` imported from `node:worker_threads` in the Worker.
workerData: `workerData` from `node:worker_threads`, written by the launcher.
The Worker-side `IRuntimePeer`.
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
Use it only when the application already owns advanced endpoint assembly for the acquired channel. The callback receives the construction signal and must return a real IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure rolls back construction; omission uses canonical assembly.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
Use the report session’s signing and verification policy when both channel ends require authenticated traffic. openSignedReportChannel supplies the matching remote configuration. Omission adds no authentication middleware.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Receives background errors that no call can reject with.
`defaultRpcReporter`.
Set a sink when the application needs to collect background or contained failures separately from request rejections. Omitting it uses defaultRpcReporter and console.error; it does not make a failed request successful.
keyFactory: Advanced remote-proxy key callback returning an application string for automatically keyed retry paths. The direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read this inherited field itself.
Omitted: proxy paths use defaultRpcId when generating keys; direct peer call keys retain their own call-option semantics.
Use it on managed proxy paths that generate keys for retryable calls. A borrowed direct connect/listen peer does not read it. Omission uses defaultRpcId in proxy paths and leaves direct call-option keys unchanged.
retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
connect: Application-supplied Core source callback that opens a borrowed channel; select exactly one source.
Omitted: no custom connection source.
listen: Application-supplied Core source callback accepting channel sessions; cannot be combined with another source.
Omitted: no custom listening source.
spawn: Worker to start: `URL`, path string (relative to the main entry directory), `true` (the current entry), `{ entry, base?, name?, data?, limits? }`, or a full source.
Not set: inside a library Worker connects to the parent; otherwise `connect` is needed.
parameters: options: IRuntimeThreadPeerOptions
parentPort: IThreadParentPort | null
workerData: unknown

configuration.descriptionZh: `createThreadPeer<TRemote>(options, runtime?)` 返回 typed Peer。`TRemote` 默认 `Record<never, never>`，只约束调用端类型，不注册 Worker 方法。`IRuntimeDynamicSurface` 可以放宽静态路径检查，运行时仍以对端真实目录为准。默认本地身份为 `{ name: 'thread', instanceId: 自动生成值 }`；需要稳定地址时显式传 `self.name`、`self.instanceId`。

endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.

endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.

self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.

provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.

providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Opens a Runtime Peer to a Worker. In the parent, `spawn` starts the Worker (URL, path, `true` for the current entry, or a full source). Inside a library-launched Worker, calling it without a source connects back to the parent. Resolves after handshake.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import createThreadPeer from @migaia/rpc-threads, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use createThreadPeer when its function contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when createThreadPeer does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained function example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
Move CPU-heavy parsing, compression or image work off the main thread.
Call Worker functions with types instead of hand-written `postMessage` dispatch.
Process isolation (crash containment, separate permissions): use `@migaia/rpc-process`.
`SharedArrayBuffer` / `Atomics` shared memory: rejected.

declaredConfiguration.name: retryPort
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional whole-invocation retry policy; omission sends once.
