options: Same `spawn` / `provide` as `createThreadPeer`, plus `name` (connection name in the host) and optional `expose` (host method paths the Worker may call).
runtime: Advanced: custom Node `worker_threads` resource.
A plugin for `host.use()`.
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
Use it only when the application already owns advanced endpoint assembly for the acquired channel. The callback receives the construction signal and must return a real IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure rolls back construction; omission uses canonical assembly.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
Use the report session’s signing and verification policy when both channel ends require authenticated traffic. openSignedReportChannel supplies the matching remote configuration. Omission adds no authentication middleware.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
Connect the export monitor when a report plugin needs message activity observations. The callback forwards events to the application sink; omission installs no observer.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Receives background errors that no call can reject with.
`defaultRpcReporter`.

keyFactory: Advanced remote-proxy key callback returning an application string for automatically keyed retry paths. The direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read this inherited field itself.

retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
connect: Application-supplied Core source callback that opens a borrowed channel; select exactly one source.
Omitted: no custom connection source.
listen: Application-supplied Core source callback accepting channel sessions; cannot be combined with another source.
Omitted: no custom listening source.
spawn: Worker to start: `URL`, path string (relative to the main entry directory), `true` (the current entry), `{ entry, base?, name?, data?, limits? }`, or a full source.

name: Caller-selected nonempty registration name copied when constructing the cold plugin; use the same name when addressing the installed runtime outlet.
expose: Distinct nonempty paths explicitly exposing current Host feature methods, runtime connection routes or the reserved host control entry. Only this snapshotted whitelist becomes remotely callable.
Omitted: an empty whitelist; only provide methods are published.
host: The same actual PluginHost handle into which this plugin is installed, supplying use, unUse, plugin and revision for explicit host exposure.
Omitted: allowed unless expose contains host; explicit host exposure requires host, catalog and resolvePlugin together.
catalog: Application-authored IRemoteHostCatalog declaring the only plugin contracts available through explicitly exposed host control.
Omitted: no host-control catalog; required when expose contains host.
resolvePlugin: Synchronous local resolver invoked by the canonical host-control owner after catalog admission; definitions remain local and are installed through the original Host.
resolvePlugin.name: Plugin name admitted by the declared catalog.
resolvePlugin.config: Optional portable configuration from the remote host-use request.
Local plugin definition accepted by the Host; a thrown error rejects the host-use request.
Omitted: no local resolver; required when expose contains host.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Creates a plugin that installs one Worker connection into a PluginHost; the host owns and releases it and gains the `host.thread` outlet.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import createThreadPlugin from @migaia/rpc-threads, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use createThreadPlugin when its function contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when createThreadPlugin does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained function example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

resources: Resource measurements belong to the execution unit behind each connection. The local Peer returns an unavailable value here rather than a combined measurement. Inspect a connection for the resource information its runtime supports.

endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
Use it only when the application already owns advanced endpoint assembly for the acquired channel. The callback receives the construction signal and must return a real IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure rolls back construction; omission uses canonical assembly.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.

authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.

Omitted: no observer is added by this field.

symbols.purpose: A Runtime Peer typed by `TRemote`: method names, payloads and results are checked against the other side API. Also has `self`, `describe()`, `outcome()`, `on()` and `close()`.
symbols.core:
self: Frozen local peer name and instanceId minted or supplied during this connection construction; it is not a remote authentication principal.
outcome: Queries the original remote operation ledger for a prior idempotency key, without dispatching that operation again.
outcome.idempotencyKey: The caller-issued key supplied as options.idempotencyKey on an earlier request to this connection.
Promise of IRpcRuntimeOutcomeResult; support and availability come from the accepted remote runtime contract.
describe: Queries the local accepted peer detail asynchronously. Without format returns IRuntimeDetail; json, yaml or toml returns the admitted text projection. It does not claim unavailable physical metrics.
describe.options: Optional query format from IRuntimeQueryOptions; omitted returns the object snapshot.
Promise of local detail or formatted text, following the selected query format.
on: Registers a future RuntimeEventName listener after construction; factory resolution already represents initial readiness. Listener return is ignored and failures are contained by the runtime reporter.
on.event: A RuntimeEventName value such as ready or exit; it selects future connection lifecycle notifications.

describe: Queries the local accepted peer detail asynchronously. Without format returns IRuntimeDetail; json, yaml or toml returns the admitted text projection. It does not claim unavailable physical metrics.

blocks.text: Node launcher 的原生 Worker 构造参数被拒绝时，使用 Core INVALID_CONFIG 标识；若已有原生 code，则以包装错误保留原 Error、name、message、stack 和原生 code 于 cause，不覆盖它们。此分类只描述 Node 构造边界，不泛化为所有 Web 构造器异常。

本包本地错误码对象 RpcThreadErrorCode 只有 usageSampleFailed，值为 THREAD_USAGE_SAMPLE_FAILED，RPC_THREAD_ERROR_SOURCE 为 @migaia/rpc/threads。调用、监督和 Host 边界各使用自己的 source，不把所有失败改成本包采样码。按 source / code 分支，不匹配 message 文本；业务异常跨 Worker 后保留原生类型、message、stack、source/code 与 cause / errors 链，不能承诺接收端对象与发送端同一 identity。
Worker 单独运行配置失败通常是没有库 launcher bootstrap；默认 buffer 未失效是复制语义；Worker 是否重启取决于 restart 策略。需人工恢复时用 Host 的 restart / replace，并查看 list / get 的当前代次与退出信息。
下表区分线程采样、监督、Core 与 Remote 的错误来源。线程 API 从 `@migaia/rpc-threads` 导入；Core 与 Remote API 分别从 `@migaia/rpc-core` 和 `@migaia/rpc-core/remote` 导入，`source` 值保留各自的错误身份。

configuration.descriptionZh: 在 Peer 的 connect callback 中把 `context.capabilities` 交给 channel，并让两端同时开始。context.self 是 Core 为本地准备的真实地址；peerId 表示对端连接。显式 capabilities 可缩小提案，不可扩大实际 launch offer、伪造协商或信任。逻辑 channel.close / Peer.close 解除自己的监听和 observer，不物理关闭借入端口；调用方最后关闭原生端口。固定 raw channel 不等于完整 runtime Peer。

sections.content:
options: `{ scheduler, capabilities? }`: use the same `scheduler` as the source; `capabilities` intersects the actual launch offer; only the peer acknowledgement establishes the agreed result.
A channel factory with `open(handle, signal)`.
scheduler: Clock and timers, shared with the source.
capabilities: Local capability proposal; extensions wait for the other side acknowledgement.
Not set: fixed basic profile, synchronous.

symbols.core:
options: Optional `{ runtimeApi?, execArgv? }`: `execArgv` sets runtime flags for the Worker; omitted, Node inheritance applies.
An `IThreadLauncher` from `@migaia/supervision/threads`, used as `spawn.launcher`.
runtimeApi: Advanced `IRuntimePeerSourceContext` supplied by the Core source owner; per-launch held metadata takes precedence over this configured context.
Omitted: only private per-launch metadata can supply runtime API bootstrap.
execArgv: Caller-selected runtime argument list copied for each native Worker. If new Worker throws synchronously, launch rejects with Core INVALID_CONFIG. An existing native code such as ERR_WORKER_INVALID_EXEC_ARGV is not overwritten: the original Error, code, name, message and stack remain on cause under the established conflict policy. This classification does not cover later asynchronous Worker business failures.
Omitted: preserve Node’s native execution-argument inheritance.
